units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 47:16">Targ. Y. Gen. XLVII, 16</cite> (h. text) <he>אפס</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 44:3">Targ. Ps. XLIV, 3</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>שלח</he>).

<cite ref="Pesachim 55b:7">Pes. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>פַּסְדָא לה ביעי לגמרי</he> she (the hatching hen) has spoiled the eggs entirely (made them unfit to be eaten).—Part. pass. <cite ref="Q01275"><he>פָּסֵיד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 55b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>אכתי לא פְסֵידֵי ביעי וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>פסיד לה ביעא</he>; Ms. K. <he>לא פַסְדָּה לה</he>) the eggs are not yet entirely spoiled.
<cite ref="Ketubot 56a">Keth. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>איהו הוא דא׳ אנפשיה</he> he brought the loss upon himself.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 139b:5">B. Bath. 139ᵇ</cite> <he>אינהו אַפְסִידוּ אנפשייהו</he> they brought the loss &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 108b:7">Sabb. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>אַפְסוּדֵי קא מַפְסִידְנָא ליה</he> (by salting the radish) I vitiate it.
<cite ref="Ketubot 61b:1">Keth. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>אַפְסְדַת לסעודתא וכ׳</he> (Rashi: <he>אַפְסַדְתָּא</he>) thou hast spoiled the king’s meal.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 117b:13">B. Mets. 117ᵇ</cite> <he>כמה מַפְסְדָה עלייה בבית</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מפסיד</he>, corr. acc.) by how much does the upper story impair (the durability of) the lower story?; a. fr.
